title: Lead Quality Assurance Analyst (Bilingual English-French)
description:
Location - Canada / Remote

Sapiens is seeking a dynamic and experienced Lead Quality Assurance Analyst (Bilingual English-French) to oversee the quality assurance efforts for a complex, integrated platform comprising multiple modules. This role requires hands-on leadership, strategic planning, and technical expertise in both manual and automation testing. The Lead Quality Assurance Analyst will manage a hybrid QA team, drive platform-wide quality initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and high-quality delivery.

Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Planning

• Define and implement comprehensive test strategies for manual and automation testing across modules.

• Translate business and technical requirements into test artifacts including test cases, automation scripts, and test plans.

• Plan and estimate QA efforts during sprint planning and release cycles.

• Ensure alignment with QA best practices, design patterns, and organizational standards.

Test Execution & Platform Oversight

• Oversee execution of manual and automated test cases across functional, regression, integration, and UAT phases.

• Validate end-to-end workflows across integrated modules and shared services.

• Coordinate system-level testing across environments (staging, pre-prod, production).

• Monitor automation coverage and maintain regression suite health.

Defect & Risk Management

• Identify, document, and track defects; collaborate with development and BA teams for resolution.

• Evaluate defect impact across modules and prioritize based on business and technical risk.

• Proactively identify platform-level quality risks and implement mitigation strategies.

Metrics & Compliance

• Create and distribute QA reports covering test progress, defect metrics, risk mitigation plans, and platform KPIs.

• Review and act on quality indicators such as defect leakage, test case effectiveness, and release confidence.

• Ensure compliance with QA standards, audit requirements, and regulatory guidelines.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead and mentor a team of manual and automation QA engineers.

• Support onboarding, training, and continuous learning for team members.

• Conduct performance reviews and foster a culture of accountability and excellence.

Collaboration & Communication

• Act as the primary QA contact for product, development, and delivery teams.

• Collaborate with SMEs, architects, and module owners to ensure quality deliverables.

• Facilitate cross-team defect triage and platform-level release readiness meetings.

• Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement across teams.

Technical Skills

• Experience in life insurance domain (individual life and annuities) - Must

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum practices.

• Experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium frameworks).

• Knowledge of REST/SOAP API testing and interface validation.

• Ability to write SQL queries.

• Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Jira, Zephyr, QC).

Leadership & Communication

• Proven experience managing hybrid QA teams and platform-level testing.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Experience in client-facing roles (e.g., pre-sales, UAT coordination).

• Ability to work independently and lead by example.

Qualifications

• Bilingual English French - Must

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (preferred).

• ISTQB or equivalent certification - Advantage

• 10+ years of QA experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role.

Added Advantage

• Experience in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).

• Exposure to performance, accessibility, and cross-browser testing.

• Experience in tool evaluation and selection for manual and automation testing.

• Willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
description:
Über DrAnsay
DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
Warum es diese Rolle gibt
DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
Deine Rolle
Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
Was du konkret machst

• Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

• OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

• Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

• Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

• User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

• Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

• Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

• Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

Requirements
Das brauchst du

• Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

• Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

• Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

• Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

• Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

• Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu mach

title: Pricing Lead
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Preferable to have someone near an office in NYC or San Francisco, but open to hiring around the world for the right candidate.

Runway Creative is an all-in-one platform giving creators and businesses endless ways to generate and edit video, images, and audio. Our customers range from individual creators on self-serve plans to studios and enterprise marketing teams, and they generate with both Runway's own models and leading third-party models, all on one platform.

We're hiring a Pricing & Packaging Lead to own how Runway creates and captures value across all of it. You'll partner closely with our Self-Serve Product Lead to evolve our plans and credits, build the path from self-serve to enterprise, and set the pricing for every model we launch and every third-party model we serve. You'll build the pricing framework the rest of the company uses, and you'll be accountable for revenue growth, gross margin, and customer trust in equal measure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own self-serve pricing & packaging: partner with the Self-Serve Product Lead on our plan ladder and credit design, including allowances, rollover, top-ups, annual vs. monthly, and regional pricing. Run a continuous program of pricing and packaging experiments with Growth and Data.

- Build the path to enterprise: design the triggers, team and workspace constructs, seat and credit-pool models, and commit and consumption contracts that move customers from self-serve to enterprise. Equip Sales with pricing playbooks, discount bands, and deal guardrails.

- Create a company-wide pricing framework: publish Runway's pricing principles, value metrics, and decision process so any product team can price new features and products with confidence. Run a regular pricing council with Product, Finance, Research, and GTM.

- Price our models: set launch pricing for every Runway model release, working with Research and Infrastructure on cost-to-serve. Define how model pricing evolves from launch through deprecation as inference costs change.

- Own third-party model economics: set credit pricing and target margins for the partner models we serve, monitor competitive pricing, and work with Partnerships on vendor terms. Make per-model margin visible to the whole company.

- Keep pricing changes trustworthy: own how we communicate every pricing change, from advance notice and in-product usage visibility to spend controls and customer FAQs. Changes should land as clearly as they were designed.

- Build the team: hire and lead a small pricing team over time, and partner closely with billing engineering to turn decisions into systems.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 10+ years across pricing, monetization, strategy, or strategic finance, with 5+ years directly owning pricing and packaging decisions. A track record of moving revenue, conversion, and margin, not just producing recommendations.

- Deep experience with usage, credit, or consumption-based pricing. You can build a cost-to-serve and margin model from compute and infer

title: Platform Quality Engineer
description:
About StarCompliance

StarCompliance is on a mission to make compliance simple and easy. Trusted globally by enterprise financial institutions, the user-friendly STAR platform empowers organizations to achieve regulatory compliance while safeguarding their integrity and business reputations. Through a customizable, 360-degree view of employee activity, the STAR software enables firms to automate the detection and resolution of potential areas of conflict while streamlining daily workflows and increasing efficiency.
Role
The Platform Quality Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within StarCompliance ’s centralised Platform Quality Engineering function, responsible for ensuring platform-level quality assurance across the enterprise SaaS platform.
Reporting to the Lead Quality Architect, the Platform Quality Engineer contributes directly to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated quality controls that validate cross-service integration, core enterprise user journeys, and non-functional platform characteristics. The role is focused primarily on integration and API-level testing across a distributed, cloud-native system, including asynchronous and event-driven workflows.

StarCompliance ’s enterprise platform is built on distributed services and cloud infrastructure, including messaging and integration components such as Azure Service Bus. The Platform Quality Engineer is expected to understand how these systems behave under load, failure, and recovery conditions, and how to test them to ensure reliability, resilience, and performance at scale.
The role places strong emphasis on validating failure modes, resilience, and recovery behaviour across distributed services, diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data, and contributing to enterprise performance testing.
The Platform Quality Engineer works closely with Product Owners and engineering teams to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, ensuring the enterprise platform is validated under realistic functional and load scenarios ahead of release
Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and maintain automated tests primarily at the integration and API layers to validate behaviour across distributed services.

• Develop tests that validate asynchronous and event-driven workflows, including messaging, retries, ordering, and failure scenarios (e.g. Azure Service Bus-based integrations).

• Contribute production-quality code to shared automation frameworks and quality tooling used across the enterprise platform.

• Design and execute performance and scalability tests for the enterprise SaaS platform

• Build and maintain performance test data, scenarios, and workloads that reflect real-world usage patterns, including message throughput and concurrency.

• Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines, contributing to reliable, high-signal quality gates.

• Support validation activities within the Staging environment as the primary platform integration and quality assurance layer

• Analyse functional, integration, and performance test results to identify systemic platform risks and improvement opportunities.

• Partner with Product Owners to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, preparing targeted integration and performance tests in advance.

• Collaborate with architecture, platform, and engineering teams to improve system testability, reliability, and observability.

• Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test creation, improve coverage, analyse failures, and reduce test flakiness.

• Adhere to and contribute to quality standards, patterns, and engineering practices defined by the centralised Platform Quality Engineering function

Skills and Experience

• Demonstrable experience in platform- or enterprise-scale SaaS application quality assurance, with a focus on validating integration, non-functional characteristics, and release readiness across distributed systems.

description:
Who we are

At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilio ns!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio ’s next Product Operation Specialist 1.
About the job
Twilio is seeking a Product Operations Specialist I to support our Porting and Hosting Operations-a key component of Twilio ’s Global Number Management team. This role ensures customers can seamlessly port phone numbers, manage number hosting, and experience reliable service during transitions. You’ll work across carrier networks, internal tools, and product teams to troubleshoot, coordinate, and optimize porting workflows at scale.
The Level 1 role is an entry-level position ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, process-driven, with excelsior customer servicing skills and excited to work at the intersection of product, operations, and telecom. This position plays a vital role in ensuring Twilio ’s phone number experience remains best-in-class.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:

•
Wear the Customer’s Shoes : Champion the customer experience by managing inbound porting requests with care, urgency, and accuracy. Ensure customers have a seamless transition when bringing their phone numbers to Twilio or managing hosted services.

•
Be Inclusive : Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, support agents, product managers, and carrier partners. Respect different communication styles, cultures, and perspectives while driving unified outcomes.

•
Empower Others : Proactively share insights, documentation, and solutions with peers and partner teams to make operational processes easier and more transparent. Help elevate the broader team by contributing to best practices.

•
Write It Down : Maintain accurate records of porting workflows, number hosting cases, escalations, and system usage. Keep internal knowledge bases and documentation up to date to ensure reliability and consistency across teams.

•
No Shenanigans : Follow industry and regulatory standards in number portability and telecom compliance. Protect customer data and make ethical decisions when managing sensitive porting and routing scenarios.

•
Be Bold : Take initiative in solving problems and navigating complexity, even when documentation is limited. Don’t hesitate to raise questions, propose improvements, or flag issues that impact the customer experience.

•
Draw the Owl : Identify recurring issues and inefficiencies in porting and hosting operations. Use your findings to improve workflows, tooling, or automation - even when there’s no clear roadmap.

•
Don’t Settle : Aim to exceed SLAs and continuously look for ways to optimize how we execute core operations. Be relentless about quality, efficiency, and learning from mistakes.

Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio . We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Procuramos alguém que conduza a resolução de incidentes complexos com autonomia , transite com naturalidade entre o técnico e o negócio e ajude a profissionalizar a área de TechOps. Valorizamos comunicação clara com equipes técnicas e clientes, e segurança para decidir mesmo sob pressão.

• Propor e implementar melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos da área.

• Automatizar rotinas de monitoramento, observabilidade e recuperação de falhas.

• Evoluir os sistemas junto às equipes de engenharia, garantindo resiliência.

• Definir e acompanhar indicadores de sustentação (SLAs, SLOs).

• Atuar como referência técnica da área, apoiando os analistas mais juniores.

• Manter contato com clientes técnicos e de negócio, alinhando soluções em calls e chamados.

O que buscamos:

• Perfil de liderança, com experiência ou disposição para desenvolver pessoas, dar e receber feedbacks e elevar o nível das entregas.

• Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

• Capacidade de conduzir incidentes de ponta a ponta, do diagnóstico à prevenção (war rooms, post mortem).

• Conhecimento sólido de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

• Autonomia para tomar decisões na sua área, inclusive sob pressão.

• Conhecimento sólido em TypeScript e JavaScript.

• Experiência avançada com SQL e bancos relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL).

• Experiência com CI/CD, automação de processos e APIs (REST e GraphQL).

• Familiaridade com GCP ou outros provedores de cloud.

• Vivência com observabilidade (monitoramento, métricas, tracing e logs).

Diferenciais

• Experiência com sustentação, command-center ou NOC.

• Experiência com suporte direto a clientes técnicos.

• Experiência com mobile (iOS/Android).

Informações adicionais
📍 Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).
🌎 Formato: Remoto - trabalhamos de qualquer lugar.
📝 Benefícios: Cartão Flash, aulas de idiomas, Totalpass.

Nossa cultura
Nos importamos (we care): assumimos responsabilidade antes de sermos cobrados e agimos pelo impacto real no cliente, no colega e no produto, sem esperar o problema virar incidente. Somos auto-motivados (self driven): assumimos o ownership, identificamos o problema, resolvemos e fechamos o loop por iniciativa própria, porque é isso que faz a empresa crescer e gera confiança com o cliente.
Dominamos nosso ofício (we master the craft): entregamos com profundidade real, orgulho pelo resultado e inconformismo com soluções superficiais. Quem domina o ofício busca aprendizado e nunca se acomoda.
Ganhamos como time (we win as a team): removemos bloqueios e compartilhamos contexto, porque o resultado coletivo vale mais do que qualquer destaque individual. Quem ganha como time não guarda conhecimento, distribui.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join the Visual System Team, the team responsible for how OKX looks and feels across every product surface, including mobile and web. You’ll work at the intersection of brand expression and product design, crafting the visual layer that makes OKX products feel distinctive, coherent, and trusted.

This isn’t a role where you receive a finalized wireframe and simply apply a visual layer. You’ll be involved early, shaping how features are visually conceived, how brand moments are integrated into product flows, and how visual systems scale across an ecosystem of products used by millions.

You’ll work within OKX’s Visual Systems infrastructure alongside the Design System and Content System teams, contributing to scalable visual frameworks including illustration guidelines, motion principles, iconography standards, and brand-in-product patterns that raise quality across the entire product.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

• Design product visual experiences. Create high-quality visual and UI designs for OKX products across trading, wallet, payments, and social features. Own the visual execution of key product surfaces, from concept through to pixel-perfect delivery. Balance beauty with clarity in a domain where trust and usability are non-negotiable.

• Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX’s visual systems, including shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, layout patterns, UI components, and design tokens. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets and patterns, not just individual

• Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product, while adapting it thoughtfully to product goals, user needs, and performance metrics. You’ll help create room for the product’s own visual expression without going off-brand.

• Design product campaigns and key moments. Create engaging visual experiences for in-product campaigns, launches, and feature moments. These should feel distinctive and expressive while remaining native to the product experience and aligned with the broader brand.

• Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, prototyping, and asset production. You’re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra.

• Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly.

• Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices, not just what you designed,

description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. Kubernetes helped give enterprises more freedom over where and how they run software. Now we're bringing that same open approach to AI agents.

As AI agents take on more autonomous, long-running work, enterprises need infrastructure to run them securely and reliably at scale, without giving up control of their data, systems, or models. We're building open, Kubernetes-native infrastructure that brings together agent execution, secure access to tools and systems, and centralized controls for identity, permissions, and policy. This is an opportunity to help shape a foundational layer for enterprise AI while the architecture is still being defined.

We build in the open alongside the community. Our open source projects include ToolHive, an MCP platform that secures more than 20 million tool calls each month, and Mecatl, a cloud-native agent harness. Our commercial offering, Stacklok Enterprise, extends these capabilities with an AI gateway, centralized identity, policy enforcement, and observability.

Location
This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone .
The Opportunity
Enterprises are moving AI agents into production, and they want to run them the way they run everything else: on their own Kubernetes clusters, behind their firewall, and connected to the identity systems they already use. Stacklok Enterprise, our commercial platform for running and governing AI agents, is built for that, by a team whose founders co-created Kubernetes.
As a Senior Engineer on the core platform team, you will design and build major parts of the platform and own them from design through production. That work runs in customers' Kubernetes environments, so your design tradeoffs shape how the product holds up in the field. The areas you own will shift as the product grows, and you will mentor the engineers building alongside you.
Customers are onboarding now. As one of the key engineers helping them reach production, you will also work with some as design partners on our newest features and products. It is a high-ownership role in an emerging category, with a short path from customer feedback to what ships.
What Success Looks Like: First 6-12 Months

• Designed and shipped a complete subsystem end to end that is now running in production for enterprise customers.

• Helped take one or more customers from proof-of-concept to production on their own Kubernetes, and turned their feedback into a platform feature.

• Raised the team's bar by mentoring engineers and strengthening the product engineering culture.

• Improved how the team ships changes to customers, including where AI-assisted workflows helped and where they created rework.

• Became the owner and go-to decision maker for one or more platform areas, with the team routing design questions your way.

In This Role, You Will

title: Conversational AI Engineer - Google/GECX & Code Agents
description:
At TTEC Digital , we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.

As a Conversational AI Engineer specializing in Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX), you will design, deploy, and optimize next-generation, customer-facing agentic workflows. You will work on a unified platform that bridges the gap between digital discovery (via Google Search and Maps) and front-line customer operations (chat, voice, and retail/commerce touchpoints).

You will use Customer Experience Agent Studio (CX Agent Studio) to build multi-agent applications, but your core focus will be implementing Code Agents-leveraging programmatic SDKs (such as cxas-scrapi), writing custom Python/TypeScript tool callbacks, and utilizing localized CLI workflows to programmatically structure, lint, test, and sync complex agent hierarchies. You will merge the speed of low-code visual canvas building with the absolute determinism of custom-coded logic.

This is a permanent, fully remote position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be willing to work in US business hours to support our global clients and operations.

What you'll be doing:

• Develop Multi-Agent Architectures: Build and configure modular, hierarchical agent networks (Root/Steering agents and targeted Sub-agents) using a combination of the CX Agent Studio canvas and programmatic Code Agents.

• Write Custom Code Tools & Callbacks: Program specialized backend logic, data transformation scripts, and custom tool callbacks in Python or TypeScript to extend agent capabilities beyond basic natural language prompts.

• Leverage GECX Engineering CLI & Tooling: Run automated code-first developer workflows utilizing uv environments and the cxas CLI for structural static linting (cxas lint) and advanced semantic instruction validation (cxas llm-lint).

• Design Generative Playbooks & Control Flows: Author and maintain structured, XML-like agent instructions (, , ) that natively hook into custom Python tools ({@TOOL: custom_script}) and sub-agent routing syntax ({@AGENT: specialized_subagent}).

• Program Enterprise Integrations: Seamlessly hook Code Agents into live databases, product catalogs, CRMs, and CCaaS networks (e.g., Genesys, Avaya) via Model Context Protocol (MCP) or secure OpenAPI webhooks.

• Automate Quality & Evaluation (CI/CD): Script programmatic, golden-scenario test cases and simulation evals using simulation frameworks to test multi-turn agent trajectories, preventing hallucinations and conversational regressions before sync-to-prod.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or programmatic AI workflows.

• Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, with hands-on experience handling complex JSON payloads, RESTful APIs, and cloud-hosted webhooks.

• Experience utilizing Git-based developer workflows and command-line interfaces (CLIs) for software versioning and deployment.

• Hands-on experience building with Google’s GECX Code Agent tooling (e.g., cxas-scrapi workspace/SDK, Python-based agent foundries).

• Good technical understanding of Dialogflow CX, CX Agent Studio, or similar advanced, stateful conversational frameworks.

• Experience deploying streaming, low-latency audio-to-audio (A2A) voice agents and integrating with telephony (SIP/RTP) or CCaaS partner environments.

• Solid grasp of prompt engineering safety protocols, blocklists, and programmatic fallback behaviors (e.g., before_model_callback or after_tool_callback hooks).

• Experience with BigQuery or Google Cloud Logging to programmatically extract conversation traces, search text transcripts, and build data-driven performance metrics.

• Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

• Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

• Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

• Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

• Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

• A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

• High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

• Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

• Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

• Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

• Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.
We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.
We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Account Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Aufträge, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

DIE ROLLE

Du übernimmst ein eigenes Book von rund 70 bis 90 Generalunternehmern, Bauträgern und Planern und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Consulting-Team eine erfolgreiche Aktivierung sicher. Du sicherst die Verlängerung, baust Nutzung und Vertrag aus und merkst früh, wenn ein Kunde abrutscht. Wo ein Kunde noch nicht richtig angekommen ist, holst du ihn gemeinsam mit dem Consulting-Team in die Nutzung.

Verlängerungen, Upgrades und Cross-Sell verhandelst du selbst, mit Geschäftsführung, Einkauf und Kalkulation. Jede Vertragsfrist der nächsten zwölf Monate hast du im Blick, ab 120 Tagen davor läuft dein Renewal-Ablauf, und deinen Forecast pflegst du jede Woche.

Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

- Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades.

- Die Kündigungen in deinem Book liegen unter deinem Ziel, und jede Frist der nächsten zwölf Monate hat eine Renewal-Opportunity mit Forecast-Kategorie.

- Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

- Warnsignale in deinem Book, etwa sinkende Nutzung oder ein weggefallener Key User, haben schnell einen Plan.

- Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast.

WER BEI COSUNO ERFOLGREICH IST

- Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

- Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

- Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger.

- Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

DIESE ROLLE IST FÜR DICH, WENN

- du ein Book mit vielen Kunden lieber selbst steuerst, als fünf Großkunden zu betreuen.

- du Verlängerungen verhandelst und dabei den Preis hältst, statt Rabatt zu geben.

- du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast.

- du deine Zahlen kennst und sie dich motivieren.

- du mit Geschäftsführern im Mittelstand auf Augenhöhe sprichst und verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft wird.

DIESE ROLLE IST NICHTS FÜR DICH, WENN

- du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest.

- du aus Support, Service oder reinem Onboarding kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest.

- du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und 70 Kunden als zu viel empfindest.

- du lieber über Transformation präsentierst, als einen Vertrag zu verlängern.

HARTE ANFORDERUNGEN

- Rund 2 bis 3 Jahre im Account Management, Customer Success oder Sales im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit eigener Verantwortung für Bestandskunden und Umsatz.

- Belegbare Ergebnisse bei Verlängerungen, Upsell oder Kündigungen in den letzten Periode

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Financial Engineering
description:
About the Team

Financial Engineering (FinEng) builds the financial systems behind ChatGPT, Codex, and OpenAI’s API platform. These products serve people, developers, and businesses around the world. We make them easy to buy, use, and pay for. Our systems support everything from individual subscriptions to usage-based billing and complex enterprise agreements.

We also build the foundations for how products are packaged, accessed, and used: product catalogs, SKUs and bundles, workspaces, entitlements, and usage metering. These systems connect what customers purchase to the capabilities they can access and the usage they can manage.

That reach creates challenging engineering problems. We build services and data pipelines that handle large volumes of usage and transactions, keep payments, product access, and financial records consistent across systems, and adapt as products and pricing change. The same foundations must support a simple checkout and the detailed spending controls a large business needs.

Your work will help teams launch new products faster and give customers confidence in what they are paying for. The work spans customer experiences, backend services, and data systems, with opportunities to influence technical design and see your work through to production.

We’re hiring Staff+ engineers with strong backend experience. Experience in payments, billing, or financial systems is a strong plus, but not required.

In this role, you will:

- Design and build systems for purchasing, payments, subscriptions, and billing across OpenAI products and global markets.

- Build product catalogs, SKUs, and bundles that let product teams launch new offerings and evolve how products are packaged.

- Develop workspace and entitlement systems that connect purchases and subscriptions to product access for individuals and teams.

- Keep charges and product access correct when requests are retried, updates arrive late, or another service fails.

- Build metering systems, data pipelines, and APIs that turn large volumes of usage into accurate bills, timely spending information, and records that are easy to trace and verify.

- Create reusable building blocks that let product teams launch new offerings, pricing, and payment options without rebuilding the foundations each time.

- Make complex financial workflows simple for customers and internal teams, using customer feedback and experiments to improve the experience.

- Scale and evolve live systems while protecting customer access, financial accuracy, performance, and security.

- Own problems from early design through launch and operation, working with product, design, finance, and other engineering teams to make and test important technical decisions.

Nice to Have

- Experience with payments, subscriptions, pricing, billing, or other systems that manage customer purchases and revenue.

- Experience with product catalogs, packaging and bundles, workspace management, entitlements, or usage metering.

- Experience building financial or transaction systems at scale, checking that records match across systems, or supporting compliance and audits.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Senior Manager, Product Design (UI/Visual)
description:
About the team
Zillow Experience Design (ZxD) is a multidisciplinary team shaping the experiences that help people discover, buy, sell, and rent homes. Within ZxD, the Design Foundations team defines the systems, standards, and practices that elevate quality across our product ecosystem. We focus on accessibility, design systems, visual design, product design quality, and content standards.

Two design teams sit within Foundations, one focused on our cross-platform design systems and platform standards, and the other focused on our visual design practice and visual language in product. Both work together to improve design quality across our apps, website, and other digital experiences and to operationalize quality through standards, education, tooling, support and collaborations with our Product Design partners. About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager of Product Design (UI/Visual) to lead the Foundations team focused on our visual design practice and visual language. This is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of how people experience Zillow-helping Product Design teams create clearer, more cohesive, and higher-quality customer experiences through visual craft, while building the practice, guidance, and partnerships that help that quality scale.
Zillow’s recently refreshed visual identity creates an opportunity to refine how it comes to life across our apps, website, and other digital experiences. You will co-own its evolution with our Brand and Studio teams, while driving its refinement and application in Product. You’ll ensure it meets real customer and Product-team needs while remaining thoughtful and consistent.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Design Foundations, you will lead and develop a specialized team and own and evolve our Product Design partner enablement program. You and your team will engage early on priority launches and future-facing concepts, including emerging AI experiences, helping shape how Zillow continues to make home a reality for more and more people. You’ll also help define and scale Zillow’s emerging AI Visual Identity.
As AI changes how teams design and build, this role will help ensure greater speed strengthens-not erodes-visual quality. You will partner with Design Technology to build quality into AI-enabled workflows and tools.

In this role, you will
Lead a product design team focused on Zillow’s visual language

• Co-own the refinement of Zillow’s visual identity with the Brand and Studio teams, ensuring it works for Product use cases

• Own the application of Zillow’s visual identity in Product experiences, ensuring it meets real customer and Product-team needs while remaining thoughtful and consistent

• Set Product-focused visual principles, standards, and guidance that help teams create cohesive, high-quality interfaces

• Drive the evolution of the visual language of the design system, defining the Product-focused principles and guidance that shape how Zillow’s interfaces look and feel. Partner with Design Systems designers to evolve components and patterns around Product-team needs

• Engage early in priority concepts and launches to improve interface clarity, cohesion, and quality-and to identify needs that can be addressed through shared guidance or the design system

Mature our Visual Design practice and Partner Enablement programs

• Own and evolve the Partner Enablement program, pairing Foundations designers with Product Design teams to understand their needs, provide targeted guidance, and connect them with the right expertise across Design Foundations - including Design Systems, Visual Design, Engineering and Accessibility

• Use insights from those partnerships to strengthen the program and identify opportunities for focused guidance, shared solutions, and earlier collaboration with Product teams

• Mature our nascent Visual Design practice to give Product Design teams the guidance, tooling, feedback, and support to strengthen design craft in their work

title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
At Shakepay , we’re on a mission to usher in the Bitcoin golden age. We’re reimagining financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.

Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us!

About Shakepay
Since 2015, we've been on a mission to help Canadians build long-term wealth through bitcoin. Over the past few years, we've expanded beyond buying and selling bitcoin to offer a growing suite of everyday financial products - including the Shakepay Card, direct deposit, bill payments and Interac e-Transfer - making it easier to earn, save and use bitcoin every day. Today, more than 1.5 million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future as we continue to push the boundaries of what modern financial services can look like.
We’re regulated as an investment dealer across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with a funding of $44M. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we’re looking for people who want to help us build something truly special.
About the role
As a Senior Talent Partner you’ll be the primary recruiter on the team and own high-impact searches end to end. You’ll partner directly with hiring managers and senior leaders, bringing a market-informed point of view, source passive candidates and build recruiting practices that scale as Shakepay grows. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role across both technical and business searches.
What you’ll be doing

• Own full-cycle recruiting for engineering, product, design, GTM and other business roles.

• Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define roles, scope, interview process and recruiting strategy.

• Build proactive pipelines across technical and business roles through direct sourcing, target-company research, referrals, professional communities, employer-brand content and other appropriate channels.

• Bring market mapping, compensation context, realistic timelines, and recalibrate expectations when the evidence calls for it.

• Run structured hiring processes: including job descriptions, interview plans, candidate communication, scheduling and scorecards; keep our ATS (Greenhouse) accurate, coach interviewers and facilitate timely debriefs and decisions.

• Track and communicate pipeline health, conversion, candidate experience, hiring-manager responsiveness, decision speed and close risks.

• Give leaders clear progress updates, surface bottlenecks early, and improve playbooks and tools, including responsible automation and AI with human oversight.

Who we’re looking for

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including meaningful in-house experience in a high-growth startup environment.

• A record of building proactive passive candidate pipelines and closing hard-to-fill roles across multiple functions.

• Confidence advising hiring managers and senior leaders on role outcomes, leveling, market realities and trade-offs, including the judgment to push back constructively.

• Strong structured-assessment skills and enough technical fluency to turn engineering, product, data or security requirements into credible sourcing and screening plans.

• Experience managing concurrent searches, configuring applicant tracking systems and managing recruiting data to keep the recruiting function running smoothly.

• Excellent communication skills, prioritization and sound judgment.
